name: Companhia de Saneamento de Minas Gerais
summary: Companhia de Saneamento de Minas Gerais plans, executes, expands, remodels, and explores public services, basic sanitation, water supply, sewage, sanitary, and solid waste in Brazil and internationally. It is involved in collection, treatment, and distribution of treated water to end consumers; collection, transportation, recycling, treatment, and final disposal of urban, domestic, and industrial waste; and urban cleaning and solid waste management, as well as drainage and management of urban rainwater. The company was formerly known as Companhia Mineira de Água e Esgotos and changed its name to Companhia de Saneamento de Minas Gerais in November 1974. Companhia de Saneamento de Minas Gerais…
